content.user_title: Audit SEO Health and Prioritize Fixes
content.value_statement: SEO audits often mix vague recommendations with unclear priorities. This skill structures evidence, scoring, and action plans for technical, on-page, content, and authority issues.
actual_capabilities: Guides crawlability, indexation, technical SEO, on-page, content quality, and authority reviews.
Defines an SEO Health Index with weighted category scores and health bands.
Requires findings to include evidence, severity, confidence, score impact, and recommendations.
Builds prioritized action groups from the audit findings and scoring impact.
Identifies when related skills are more suitable for implementation or measurement work.
limitations: Does not guarantee ranking gains or traffic growth.
Depends on user-provided site access, analytics, crawl data, or screenshots for strong evidence.
Does not implement fixes unless the user separately asks for implementation.
Authority scoring is directional and does not replace full backlink or competitive research.

use_cases.title: Technical SEO Triage
use_cases.description: Find crawl, indexation, performance, mobile, HTTPS, and accessibility issues that limit organic visibility.

use_cases.title: Content and On-Page Review
use_cases.description: Assess titles, descriptions, headings, internal links, image handling, search intent, and content quality.

use_cases.title: SEO Health Reporting
use_cases.description: Create a scored audit with category breakdowns, evidence, and prioritized recommendations for stakeholders.

prompt_templates.title: Run a Basic SEO Audit
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner audit request for one site or section.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this site for SEO issues: [site or pages]. Focus on crawlability, indexation, technical SEO, on-page quality, and content. State assumptions if data is missing.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose Ranking Decline
prompt_templates.scenario: Investigate a known drop in organic performance.
prompt_templates.prompt: Diagnose this SEO decline using the available evidence: [traffic data, Search Console notes, changed pages, dates]. Prioritize likely causes and confidence levels.

prompt_templates.title: Score SEO Health
prompt_templates.prompt: Produce an SEO Health Index for [site or section]. Include weighted category scores, evidence, deductions, confidence, and what prevents a higher score.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Executive Action Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Turn these SEO findings into an executive action plan. Group actions by critical blockers, high-impact improvements, quick wins, and longer-term opportunities. Include expected score recovery ranges.

output_examples.input: Audit an ecommerce category section with poor organic visibility.
output_examples.output: A prioritized audit covering blocked pages, canonical conflicts, slow templates, weak titles, thin category copy, and internal linking gaps.

output_examples.input: Create an SEO Health Index from crawl and Search Console evidence.
output_examples.output: A scored report with category weights, confidence-adjusted deductions, health band, limiting factors, and evidence-backed recommendations.

output_examples.input: Prepare an SEO action plan after a migration.
output_examples.output: An action plan that separates redirect and indexation blockers from content cleanup, quick wins, and longer-term authority work.

best_practices: Provide Search Console, analytics, crawl exports, and representative URLs when possible.
Ask for a focused audit scope before requesting recommendations.
Review evidence and confidence before turning recommendations into implementation tasks.
anti_patterns: Do not treat the SEO Health Index as a guarantee of ranking performance.
Do not request fixes before the audit findings and priorities are accepted.
Do not rely on a single tool score without explaining the observed issue.

faq.question: Does this skill make SEO changes automatically?
faq.answer: No. It identifies issues and prioritizes recommendations. Implementation requires a separate user request.

faq.question: Can it audit technical SEO and content together?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers crawlability, indexation, technical foundations, on-page optimization, content quality, and authority signals.

faq.question: What data improves the audit quality?
faq.answer: Search Console data, analytics, crawl exports, PageSpeed results, log data, screenshots, and representative URLs improve confidence.

faq.question: Does the SEO Health Index replace detailed findings?
faq.answer: No. The score summarizes readiness, but every deduction should trace back to a specific finding.

faq.question: Can this skill diagnose ranking drops?
faq.answer: Yes. It can organize evidence around recent changes, indexation issues, technical problems, content gaps, and external factors.

faq.question: Is this skill useful without tool access?
faq.answer: Yes, but conclusions will be lower confidence. Strong audits need direct evidence from pages, crawls, or reporting tools.
